That branch checks neither `FORM_SUBMIT` nor the captcha result computed immediately above it, and `resendActivationMail()` leads to `OptInToken::send()`, which has no rate limit at all.

### Impact

Anyone on the internet can make a Contao installation send unlimited mail to an address of their choosing, from the site's own sender and reputation, at one outbound message per HTTP request. That is both a nuisance for the recipient and a deliverability risk for the site operator. The same request is a reliable account oracle for "this address has a pending registration on this site", which is exactly the sort of membership fact a public site is usually expected not to disclose.

**Honest bound.** The target must have an unconfirmed registration, that is `tl_member.disable = 1` together with an unconfirmed `reg-` opt-in token. An attacker can create that state for an arbitrary address, since registration requires no ownership proof, but on a site where `reg_activate` is off the branch is unreachable.", "ghsa_id": "GHSA-mfxh-vp55-7gc6", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-10-09T20:54:04Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-mfxh-vp55-7gc6", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-mfxh-vp55-7gc6"}, {"type": "CVE", "value": "CVE-2026-107843"}], "nvd_published_at": null, "published_at": "2026-10-09T20:54:04Z", "references": ["https://github.com/contao/contao/security/advisories/GHSA-mfxh-vp55-7gc6", "https://github.com/contao/contao/commit/2ea6117f9049db7221679251cfc41e67d941a74b", "https://github.com/contao/contao/releases/tag/5.3.50", "https://github.com/contao/contao/releases/tag/5.7.12", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-mfxh-vp55-7gc6"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/contao/contao/security-advisories/GHSA-mfxh-vp55-7gc6", "severity": "medium", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/contao/contao", "summary": "Contao: The registration module re-sends activation mails", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-10-09T20:54:07Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-mfxh-vp55-7gc6", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "5.3.50", "package": {"ecosystem": "composer", "name": "contao/core-bundle"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": ">= 4.1.0, < 5.3.50"}, {"first_patched_version": "5.7.12", "package": {"ecosystem": "composer", "name": "contao/core-bundle"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": ">= 5.4.0-RC1, < 5.7.12"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
